sources.title: Benchmark: Muse-Glimmer-30B INT4 on MLX EP vs CPU (M1 Max)
sources.snippet: The exact native route consumes the original packed asymmetric INT4 initializer directly and avoids expanding approximately 30B parameters to roughly 120 GB of FP32 weights. The faster SDOT route dynamically quantizes block32 activations and consumes the original ONNX packed weights without creating a second model-sized KleidiAI RHS pack.

sources.title: meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Dense 29.6B vision-language model with a ViT-G/14 perception encoder and 128K context, distilled from Muse Spark for local agentic use. Emits channel-scoped reasoning and XML-style ATEM tool calls rather than JSON, so it needs the dedicated `muse_glimmer` tool-call and reasoning parsers.
